# cork-nav-sub

A sub menu, rendered as a drill-down, with an optional title above it.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `navAriaLabel` | `String` | Label for the nav. Default: the title's text, or 'Submenu' if there's no title. Attribute: nav-aria-label. |
| `autoHeight` | `Boolean` | On wide screens, makes the drill-down as tall as its first menu level, following changes to that menu's size. On narrow screens its height is auto. Attribute: auto-height. |
| `focusedNavItem` | `Number[]` | navPosition of the focused item, e.g. [1, 0]. Attribute: focused-nav-item, comma-separated (e.g. "1,0"). |

## Slots

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| (default) | Title and menu. Not an actual slot, but rather parsed and rendered into the shadow DOM by controllers. The title is an h1-h6, or a div/span with the data-heading attribute (optionally a level, e.g. data-heading="h2", for that level's look), optionally wrapping a link or button. See [`HeadingController`](../utils/controllers/HeadingController.md). The menu is a ul/ol of li elements, nested for sub menus. See [`NavController`](../utils/controllers/NavController.md) for the markup formats. |

## Events

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `cork-nav-item-click` | Fired when a rendered menu link or button is clicked, with the clicked item in detail.navItem. See [`NavController`](../utils/controllers/NavController.md). |
| `cork-heading-click` | Fired when a linked title is clicked, with the title in detail.heading. See [`HeadingController`](../utils/controllers/HeadingController.md). |

## Examples

**Import**

```js
import '@ucd-lib/cork-theme/elements/cork-nav-sub';

// or the class only, without registering the element:
import CorkNavSub from '@ucd-lib/cork-theme/elements/cork-nav-sub/cork-nav-sub.js';
```

**Use**

```html
<cork-nav-sub>
  <h2><a href="/services">Services</a></h2>
  <ul>
    <li><a href="/services/borrow">Borrowing</a></li>
    <li><button>Printing</button></li>
  </ul>
</cork-nav-sub>
```

**Title variations**

```html
<!-- unlinked -->
<h2>Services</h2>
<!-- a button, whose click listeners still run -->
<h2><button>Services</button></h2>
<!-- not an actual heading element, but styled like an h2 -->
<div data-heading="h2">Services</div>
```
